rubenstein-sukkot: Jeffrey L. Rubenstein, The History of Sukkot in the Second Temple and Rabbinic Periods, Brown Judaic Studies 302 (1995)
talmud-sanhedrin-43a: Babylonian Talmud (completed about AD 500–600), tractate Sanhedrin 43a, on the execution of Yeshu
talmud-yoma-85b: Babylonian Talmud (completed about AD 500–600), tractate Yoma 85a–b, on saving life on the Sabbath
jerome-pelagians: Jerome, Dialogue against the Pelagians (about AD 415), book 2, section 17
augustine-adulterous: Augustine, On Adulterous Marriages (De adulterinis coniugiis, about AD 419–420), book 2, section 7
keith-pericope: Chris Keith, The Pericope Adulterae, the Gospel of John, and the Literacy of Jesus (2009)
knust-wasserman: Jennifer Knust and Tommy Wasserman, To Cast the First Stone: The Transmission of a Gospel Story (2019)
book-of-mormon: The Book of Mormon (1830; current edition of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, 2013)
bauer-trau-keinem-fuchs: Elvira Bauer, Trau keinem Fuchs auf grüner Heid und keinem Jud bei seinem Eid ("Trust no fox on the green heath and no Jew on his oath"), Stürmer-Verlag, Nuremberg, 1936; English translation in the German Propaganda Archive, Calvin University
luther-jews-lies-1543: Martin Luther, On the Jews and Their Lies (Von den Juden und ihren Lügen, 1543)
